about: Strict placement packets and explicit discrepancy history. No packet is a photographic match or source survey by default. See docs/PLACEMENT_VERIFICATION.md. Open discrepancies override positive checks; resolution requires a fresh same-feature independent approval.

reports.notes: User reports BARRAKA BEACH planter is in the wrong place. Current [35,122] is an estimate; exact correction has not been independently measured. Earlier reviews and passing clearance tests do not establish this position.

reports.reportedBy: Project owner clarification, independently checked against originals and maps
reports.notes: Green aisle is immediately left/northeast of actual Barraka looking seaward; previous southwest run anchors the whole planter arrangement on the wrong flank. Draft candidate moves aisle/planter by [+1,-20]m; exact ground trace/endpoints remain unapproved. See independent review. No closure inferred from software checks or owner side identification.

Draft bounded stone rectangle improves the observed material but ends and width are estimates, concealed in aerial shade/vegetation. Complete physical corner controls/held-out registration and full-vertex measurements are unavailable; current Eva crossing disagrees with the continuous photographed corridor. No <=2m approval or resolution of earlier south-gate photo disagreement.

Photo shows a tall east hedge continuing inward from the gate. Draft includes only gate-side fragment, stopping clear of retained Eva route. Source does not establish an actual hedge gap at that route, nor independently measured endpoints. Continuation/route relationship remains unresolved.

Source-relative tunnel draft has no world-map transform. Existing material mask/phone GPS do not register the full entrance, side recesses or garden exit. Owner authorized guessed recess depth/generic concealed doors, not a surveyed global footprint. Register identifiable corners/connections before placing this component on the resort map.

Approximate west-side main-map integration candidate is compatible with registry portal/courtyard topology. EXIF heading disagrees; opposite northeast host remains possible. No identified source controls or measured approval. Existing world-registration report remains open.

Owner suspects gate, bench and planter are too close to pool. Independent satellite/photo assessment confirms planted lawn/approach buffer, but foliage and roof projection conceal exact ground gate/bench anchors. Current model water-ring distance: gate7.58m; bench front centre6.49m. These are model diagnostics, not source measurements. No translation applied; retain as unresolved.

measuredApprovals.rule: Measured approval (Dave, 2026-11-01): changed edges against at least two solved photo cameras, rms 0.3 m or less, worst and held-out reported, reviewed by a second agent.
measuredApprovals.change: data/pool_ring_corrections.json (north-east-tongue, north-south-west-tongue); deck widths refitted in data/pool_decks.json; ladders o2, o3 moved
measuredApprovals.limitations: The three cameras share one roof station (solved separately) and disagree by about 0.25 m from one to the next in z; IMG_2204 sits 0.35 m rms from the unchanged registry edges. The aerial cannot resolve the tongues. The south-west tongue's west foot is hidden and keeps the registry vertex; the ladder recess is not modelled. Not a survey.

reviewer.notes: Re-run of measure_pool_ring.py matches the record exactly (fit 0.14 m rms, worst 0.29; held-out 0.18, worst 0.28). 16 picks spot-checked at 8x: all on the coping water edge except held-out 2205 (82.5,897.5) and 2206 (1491.7,883), which are interpolated over the unmodelled ladder recess (about 0.5-0.6 m wide). Without them held-out is 0.17 m rms (n=7). Yellow is on the edge and far better than red at both tongues and the pocket. The renders show square tongues with no corner artefacts, and o2 and o3 are where the photos show the ladders. Limits: one station, and the cameras put the SW north edge at z 22.25, 22.55 and 22.8 (the mean is used). Already wrong before this change and out of scope: pump box o4 sits about 1 m west of its photographed position, and the ladder fitting renders low or small against the photo's tall rails.

measuredApprovals.rule: Measured approval (Dave, 2026-11-01): changed points against at least two solved photo cameras, rms 0.3 m or less, worst and held-out reported, reviewed by a second agent.
measuredApprovals.change: Pump box o4 moved from (-172.66, 20.19) to (-171.28, 19.60) and turned 40.1 degrees (new optional `turn` on pump boxes in src/slice.ts); refitted after the first review found one base pick was a glass panel's edge, not the box's corner.

measurements.method: scripts/fit_pump_box.py: a 1.1 x 0.9 x 0.57 m box on the 0.82 m deck fitted by centre and turn to visible corners in two solved cameras
measurements.heldOut: None separate: every visible corner is used in the fit (8 corners, 3 parameters). The reviewer's independent picks of the same corners are the check.

measuredApprovals.limitations: All visible corners are used to fit; no separate held-out corner exists. The model box is 1.1 m long against about 1.2 m in the photo, and has louvres on all four sides where the photo shows them on one face.

reviewer.notes: Refit confirmed. fit_pump_box.py reproduces centre (-171.28, 19.60) and turn 40.1 degrees, with misses of 1.2-10.2 px (0.08 m rms, worst 0.15 m). Projected through both cameras, the refit box lies on the photographed lid and base: within 2 px in IMG_2205 except the top-right corner at 10 px, and a steady 8-10 px left in IMG_2204 (that camera's lean). Reviewer held-out check: the IMG_2204 base front (about 1275,852) and base left (about 1237,819) corners, not used in the fit, miss by about 9 px each (about 0.11 m). The renders match both photos in position and turn. Remaining limits, left to follow-ups: the model box is 1.1 m long against about 1.2 m measured, and it has louvres on all four sides.

previousReviews.notes: Box now sits where both photos show it, about 1.4 m east of the old spot. The model box projected through both solved cameras misses my independent corner picks (IMG_2205 base left/front, top left/front/right; IMG_2204 top left/front/right) by 0.14 m rms, worst 0.23 m, inside the 0.3 m tolerance. But fit pick (684,799) in IMG_2205 is not the base corner: it is where the glass panel edge crosses the box's right vertical edge, about halfway up. The hidden base is at about (684,813), which casts to (-170.67,19.80), about 0.5 m from the recorded (-170.69,19.30). IMG_2205's own top-right corner misses by 16 px, so the residual is not only IMG_2204's lean. A joint fit to both cameras gives centre (-171.28,19.62) and a turn of about 40 degrees. Recommend refitting and re-checking before merge; the current placement passes as it is. The model puts louvres on all four sides, but the photo shows them on one face only.
previousReviews.ofChange: Pump box o4 moved from (-172.66, 20.19) to (-171.37, 19.45) and turned 52.6 degrees (new optional `turn` on pump boxes in src/slice.ts).

measurements.method: scripts/measure_elena_junction_lawns.py: pixel picks cast through the solved cameras of ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17.jpg and IMG_2358.jpg onto the model ground and compared with the edges they belong on, wall residuals signed (+ = lawn side of the face). Wall-foot picks at the grass line as the first review required.
measurements.aerial: public/map/ground.json (Esri zoom 19): lawn extent and west limit, see aerial-plan-after.jpg

heldOut.what: far length's foot 20 and 24.5 m out, both on the lawn side; the far length was not refitted (south end held at the registry corner)

measuredApprovals.limitations: Both cameras stand at the same parapet within 0.5 m, so their depth errors are not independent; the aerial supports the lawn extent but not kerb or wall-face lines. Beyond about 20 m (far wall, gate) depth is not measured. The lawn north edge is hidden in both photos and follows the aerial. Ground height under the lawns is the model's terrain. The lane-kerb points are controls in both solves; the wall-foot points set the straight run. The far length exceeds 0.3 m on its two held-out points and stays open.

previousReviews.notes: Script reproduces (0.19 m rms, worst 0.55) but its near wall-foot picks (700,940) and (745,978) sit 14-22 px up the lit wall face and its wall residual is unsigned. Ten independent wall-foot picks at the grass/white boundary (ELENA-ROOF 5, IMG_2358 5), signed: +0.27 +0.28 +0.28 +0.10 -0.22 / +0.42 +0.43 +0.24 -0.20 -0.36, 0.30 m rms, worst 0.43, systematic: the main run is still 0.27-0.47 m too far west, and the photographed foot runs straight on 5-6 m to the bed-door pier where the model's 1.1 m jog stands up to 0.36 m out on lawn (IMG_2367 agrees). The photographed bed door is about 0.4 m east of the main-run line in both cameras against 1.05 m for the moved door (about 0.65 m too far east; 0.38 m rms with it); IMG_2330 bearing 195 deg fits it at 189-193 deg against 185.8 deg for the moved door, and check_door_sills.py was relaxed from 8 to 10 deg to pass it. Wall ends slide correctly along cervantes-patio-south-2 and registry part5 edge 41. Lane-kerb lawn edges (0.00 to -0.04 m, but the kerb is a solve control), cross-path kerb (-0.13..+0.08 m), lane/path-only kerbs and the elena-24-south-patio porch suppression (open patio in ELENA-ROOF, IMG_2358, IMG_2367) are sound. Required: re-pick the foot, refit the wall shape (main run about 0.3-0.45 m further east to the bed-door pier, short projection at the bed door), move the bed sill, revert the 10 deg tolerance, carry the lawn west edges.
